Iowa Veterinary Specialties
Iowa Veterinary Specialties is Des Moines' premier veterinary emergency and specialty hospital.
IVS is an emergency and specialty hospital full of trusted veterinary professionals that partner with pet families to provide compassionate care. Our team is dedicated to serve our community through education and excellence.
Iowa Veterinary Specialties
is honored and privileged to be able to help your pet. Our veterinarians work with your pet's primary, referring veterinarian to ensure optimal communication and the best care possible.

Veterinary Services
24 Hour Emergency Vet
Iowa Veterinary Specialties is a 24-hour hospital that provides comprehensive emergency care for pets in critical need. Our facility remains open around the clock, 365 days a year, ensuring that expert medical attention is always available—no matter the time of day or night. With a deep commitment to both clinical excellence and compassionate care, our staff is equipped to handle a wide range of emergencies.
Learn More
Surgery
IVS offers a wide range of surgical services should surgery be necessary, including emergency surgery when needed. We will do a full physical exam from nose to tail and speak with you about all your concerns. Our goal is to make sure you are fully informed regarding your pet’s condition and necessary surgery as well as the aftercare.
Learn More
Veterinary Pain Management
Animals do not communicate their pain in the same manner as people. In fact, it is their natural instinct to conceal their pain. Unfortunately, these misconceptions can lead to pain being neglected when animals are sick, injured, or after having a surgical procedure performed.
Learn More
Endoscopic Foreign Body Removal
Endoscopy provides an excellent option as an alternative for surgery, because it is less expensive and more cost effective. These procedures minimize recovery time and reduce post-operative discomfort for your patients. All of our full-time doctors are trained on endoscopy.
Learn More
Blood Products
We are proud to offer in-house veterinary blood products to support critically ill and injured patients. Having immediate access to blood products allows our team to act quickly when minutes matter the most.
Learn More
Computed Tomography (CT)
At IVS, we offer 24/7 access to advanced CT imaging for rapid and accurate diagnosis. Our 64-slice CT scanner provides high-resolution images that help us improve treatment plans, and patient outcomes.

Reviews
See what clients are saying about
Iowa Veterinary Specialties
.
Whitney S.
The care received for our pet was wonderful. The entire staff was supportive and helpful from check in to discharge. We were so thankful for such a wonderful team during an uncertain and worrisome time. Truly, the entire staff from first contact to discharge was great. It was very much appreciated and helped make the situation easier to navigate. What we appreciated most is the caring & knowledge staff.
Katherine C.
The team at IVS is amazing. They all seem very invested in making our dog feel comfortable and loved and you can tell they strive to provide the best care possible. Any staff member that took care of Buckley, from checking him in all the way through discharge - we appreciate you all. Everyone we come into contact with at the clinic seems to have had a hand in taking care of Buckley and it means the world to us to feel safe and confident leaving him in your care. What I appreciated most is the communication with all staff. I never feel like I'm asking too many questions or they don't have time to address my concerns
Carleen C.
As always, incredibly thorough and competent care received from highly educated and utmost competent staff. This was the second time that Rhett received care at your clinic and I am always impressed and 100% satisfied. I can't recall the female doctor's name who treated my Shih Tzu Rhett on Sunday November 2nd late that night, but she was outstanding. I owe her a huge thank you for the care received and the new heart murmur diagnosis she detected in my dog Rhett. What I appreciated most is the trusted competent care I always receive there.
Miranda W.
The service and care was exceptional. I was being precautions bringing my dog in after she ingested a chicken bone. The staff provided clear facts and I was able to make an informed choice if she really needed to be seen or if I could monitor at home. The vet tech was incredible, she gave me the information I needed to make an informed decision related to the care of my dog. What I appreciated most is the honesty I receive and that I never feel like I am being "sold" treatments.
Sara W.
Iowa Veterinary Specialties has provided the most compassionate and professional care for our dog, Rocky, after he was seriously injured in an unprovoked pitbull attack. From the moment we arrived, the amazing front desk staff was calm, kind, and efficient—which is what we needed in this traumatic situation. Dr. McMurray and the amazing team went above and beyond in treating Rocky. Their expertise, communication, and genuine care gave us much peace of mind during a very emotional time. We always felt that Rocky was in the best hands. We are so grateful for IVS. They really cared for Rocky like he was theirs and supported us throughout his recovery.
Marie W.
It was past 1am, yet the staff remained incredibly warm and welcoming, never hurrying us along. They took the time to listen to our worries about Bella, showing genuine care and a desire to assist us. Carrie at the reception was particularly friendly and approachable throughout our experience. The entire team recognized that Bella was a cherished member of our family.
Tracy P.
I was impressed!  Everyone - receptionist, tech, doctor - were all very compassionate.  They provided care options and opinions.  We were not pressured or rushed to make decisions.  Is it expensive, yes!  But once we knew our Riggins was not going to make it, they provided a relaxing private room for us to spend time with him.  They even sent us home with a clay paw print impression.  They were all very kind and caring. I was dreading picking up his remains - they really did good by him and we felt he was honored.  How the remains are returning is soothing.  Then a couple days later we received a card in the mail signed by the staff.  It shows you guys really care!  Thank you for the care you provided Riggins and his humans.
